what: a single empty piece of armour, a legionnaire's segmented cuirass of blue-grey steel plates over a brick-red tunic
reads: The wide band across the top is the armour lying over the tops of the shoulders and the upper back. The ring in the middle of that band is the neck opening seen from directly above: the ring itself is a rolled brick-red cloth scarf exactly as thick as the block-out ring, and the plain {ground} background fills the entire circle inside it from rim to rim. The two long level bars reaching to the left and right edges are the shoulder guards over the outstretched upper arms, each a straight horizontal bar with a flat squared end: the inner three quarters of each bar are broad steel bands wrapped around the arm, lying side by side along the bar, and the outer quarter of each bar is a brick-red cloth sleeve with a straight vertical cuff edge exactly at the bar's end. Below the shoulder band the wide shallow rounded shape is the front of the armour over the chest, seen from steeply above and so strongly foreshortened that it is a short curved strip of steel. The small rounded lobe at the very bottom is the brick-red tunic hem over the hips, with the hanging leather straps painted inside the lobe's outline.
look: a legionnaire's segmented armour of broad mid blue-grey steel plates with dull brass fittings, banded steel shoulder guards, and a brick-red cloth tunic showing as a scarf at the neck, as puffs at the sleeve ends and as a gathered hem along the lower edge
paint: Every painted detail lies inside the block-out's silhouette, and the finished piece has the block-out's exact width, height and outline. Turn the simple forms into believable segmented plate armour: broad smooth plates of mid blue-grey steel, each edged with a bold dark line and a thin light rim; a yoke of steel plates around the red scarf ring; on each arm bar four broad overlapping steel bands, a rectangular dull brass hinge with four tiny rivets on the innermost band and a single round brass stud beside it; on the shallow chest strip two plates meeting at a centre seam closed by one small horizontal leather strap with a brass buckle; a narrow brass-edged leather belt where the chest strip meets the bottom lobe; the bottom lobe filled with gathered brick-red cloth and, at its centre, three short leather straps with brass studs and pointed brass tips ending at the lobe's lower edge
material: mid blue-grey steel plate with soft worn highlights, its dull brass hinge and studs, its brick-red cloth, its bold dark outlines between plates
